description: Merged receipt batch. scan inspects files; dry_run previews; create/create_and_confirm require explicit approval.

accounts_dimensions_id.description: Bank account dimension ID used when matching bank transactions. Required except in scan mode.

approved_manifest.description: Exact manifest returned by dry_run; required for create/create_and_confirm.

date_from.description: Optional receipt file modified-date lower bound (YYYY-MM-DD). Filters which receipt FILES are scanned; does not affect bank transactions.

date_to.description: Optional receipt file modified-date upper bound (YYYY-MM-DD). Filters which receipt FILES are scanned; does not affect bank transactions.

detail.description: Per-file results detail. Default compact omits the OCR raw_text and field_provenance; full keeps them.

file_types.description: Optional file type filter for scan mode

folder_path.description: Folder path with receipts. Provide exactly one of folder_path or file_ref.

mode.description: Workflow phase to run. Defaults to scan.

plan_handle.description: Consume-once handle from dry_run (plan_handles.create / .create_and_confirm). REQUIRED for create/create_and_confirm.

transaction_date_from.description: Optional bank accounting-date lower bound for auto-matching (YYYY-MM-DD). Independent of the receipt file date_from.

transaction_date_to.description: Optional bank accounting-date upper bound for auto-matching (YYYY-MM-DD). Independent of the receipt file date_to.

name: receipt_batch
title: Receipt Batch
